source: idea.pdf / idea.tex, Idea_05_AegisAgency (read in full; PDF and tex identical)
required_equations: verdict v_k = (decision d_k, calibrated score s_k, rationale embedding e_k)
at least n - f honest judges
latency and token/API cost linear in n (judge calls)
required_theorem_directions: Under 2f+2 < n and honest-verdict concentration, up to f Byzantine judges cannot force an adversarial aggregate verdict in the semantic verdict space (to be proven, not assumed)
Median/geometric-median rules: f < n/2 Byzantine judges cannot move the aggregate outside/far from the honest range (decision integrity and availability)
Correlated judge failures degrade or void the tolerance guarantee as inter-judge error correlation grows
Cost: judge calls, tokens, latency scale linearly in n; aggregation overhead polynomial in n and embedding dimension
required_experiment_variables: Byzantine/colluding fraction f/n swept to the 2f+2<n boundary
backbones: Llama-3, Qwen2.5, Mistral, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5
attacks: compromised judge, colluding defenders, second-order payload injection, adaptive attack on aggregation
ablations: robust aggregation on/off, payload isolation on/off, hardened judges on/off
metrics: defense success rate, ASR-under-compromise, targeted-ASR, false-positive/over-refusal rate, Byzantine tolerance fraction, detection F1/AUROC, latency, token/API cost, utility retention
forbidden_topic_drifts: federated learning as the object of study
differential privacy as a goal or mechanism
blockchain or BFT state-machine-replication protocol design
new jailbreak attack as the contribution
multimodal or embodied agents as the setting
claiming reduced ASR equals provable security
